title: What 24 Hours Without Sleep Does to Your Brain
description:
After one sleepless night, attention and reaction time can fall before you realise it.

Multiple systems change: vigilance and reaction time worsen, mood becomes less stable, and memory formation is impaired.

Effects differ by person and task; sleep deprivation is not equivalent to a fixed blood-alcohol level for everyone.

Microsleeps can occur for seconds while the person appears awake.
